title: Five Tips Five Separate Slides
tests: Tests one-to-one mapping of five supplied tips to five ordered slides without adding cover or closing slides.

exact_text.read_as: Slide 4 instead reads: Clear your desk

faults.what: Slide 4 repeats 'Clear your desk' instead of the required 'Set a timer', despite showing a timer illustration.
Layout sizing and alignment vary noticeably across slides, including number-circle sizes, headline scale, illustration placement, and bottom-rule lengths.

judge.summary: Five readable blue-and-white slides were delivered, but slide 4 repeats the first tip instead of saying 'Set a timer'.

must_haves.item: Exactly five separate 4:5 portrait images are delivered, with no extra cover or closing slide.
must_haves.why: The output contains five separate 4:5 portrait slides and no additional slides.

must_haves.item: The five supplied tips appear verbatim, one per slide, in the requested order.
must_haves.why: Slides 1, 2, 3, and 5 have the correct tips; slide 4 repeats 'Clear your desk' and omits 'Set a timer'.

must_haves.item: The slides are visibly numbered 1 through 5 in sequence.
must_haves.why: Each slide displays the corresponding number in a blue outlined circle.

must_haves.item: Each slide has an illustration relevant to its specific tip.
must_haves.why: The illustrations depict a tidy desk, silenced phone notifications, a checked task, a timer, and a hot drink for a break, matching the intended tips.

must_haves.item: All slides share a clean blue-and-white visual design with readable, unclipped text.
must_haves.why: All five use blue typography and line illustrations on white backgrounds, with fully visible, readable text.
